title: Google\Cloud\Channel\V1\Customer
name: Customer
description: Entity representing a customer of a reseller or distributor.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.name
params.description: Output only. Resource name of the customer. Format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}

params.name: data.org_display_name
params.description: Required. Name of the organization that the customer entity represents.

params.name: data.org_postal_address
params.description: Required. Address of the organization of the customer entity. Region and zip codes are required to enforce US laws and embargoes. Valid address lines are required for all customers. Language code is discarded. Use the Customer-level language code to set the customer's language.

params.name: data.alternate_email
params.description: Secondary contact email. Alternate email and primary contact email are required to have different domains if primary contact email is present. When creating admin.google.com accounts, users get notified credentials at this email. This email address is also used as a recovery email.

params.name: data.domain
params.description: Required. Primary domain used by the customer. Domain of primary contact email is required to be same as the provided domain.

params.name: data.create_time
params.description: Output only. The time at which the customer is created.

params.name: data.update_time
params.description: Output only. The time at which the customer is updated.

params.name: data.cloud_identity_id
params.description: Output only. Customer's cloud_identity_id. Populated only if a Cloud Identity resource exists for this customer.

params.name: data.language_code
params.description: Optional. The BCP-47 language code, such as "en-US" or "sr-Latn". For more information, see https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr35/#Unicode_locale_identifier.

params.name: data.cloud_identity_info
params.description: Output only. Cloud Identity information for the customer. Populated only if a Cloud Identity account exists for this customer.

params.name: data.channel_partner_id
params.description: Cloud Identity ID of the customer's channel partner. Populated only if a channel partner exists for this customer.
